analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 32.9로 과매도 구간 진입, 5일 전 35.6 대비 하락세 지속. ADX 29.4는 뚜렷한 추세 속에서 -DI(27.3)가 +DI(14.9)를 상회하며 하락 압력 우위. 그러나 주봉 ADX 18.0은 무추세 구간으로, 일봉 추세 강도와 상반. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 1.98로 급증했으나, 가격은 5일 저가 $0.07, 20일 저가 $0.07로 지지선에서 반등 시도 중이나 추세 전환 신호 미약. 52주 고가 $0.19 대비 3.2% 위치로 여전히 낮은 수준.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI at 32.9 has entered oversold territory, continuing its decline from 35.6 five days ago. ADX at 29.4 indicates a clear trend, with -DI (27.3) exceeding +DI (14.9), suggesting downward pressure. However, the weekly ADX at 18.0 signals a non-trending phase, contrasting with the daily trend strength. Volume ratio at 1.98 (compared to 5-day average) shows a surge, but the price is attempting a rebound from the $0.07 support level (matching both 5-day and 20-day lows), though signals for a trend reversal remain weak. The price is at 3.2% of its 52-week high of $0.19, indicating a low position historically.
analysis.weeklyConflict: 주봉 ADX 18.0 무추세, 일봉 ADX 29.4 뚜렷한 추세
analysis.weeklyConflictEn: Weekly ADX at 18.0 shows no trend, while daily ADX at 29.4 indicates a clear trend.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($0.07) vs SMA5 ($0.07)/SMA20 ($0.08)/SMA50 ($0.09): below mid-range, indicating weak short-to-medium term trend.
· Below SMA100 ($0.08)/SMA200 ($0.09): maintaining strong long-term downtrend.
· 52-week position (3.2%) + current price range at historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (35.6→32.9): entering oversold territory, continuing downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0001→-0.0001): holding steady, weak signals for trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band $0.07): approaching lower band, with band width narrowing to 12.91%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($0.07): aligning with 5-day/20-day lows and current price, indicating strong support.
· Swing Resistance ($0.08): aligning with SMA20 and Pivot R1, acting as short-term resistance.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (No Higher Low, No Lower High): sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.98x): surge in volume, adding conviction to price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): attempting rebound from support, trend reversal signals require confirmation.
